hypotheses.name: PONS–USDG triangle size-curve probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the WETH → PONS → USDG → WETH route may have a size-dependent after-gas net at one of the supplied exact sizes. The runner must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.02 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale quote outputs. Entry requires the selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and configured gas-safety rule for two consecutive eligible observations. The cohort includes observations at blocks 97031013 and 97175008, but those rows do not validate this route/size cell.

hypotheses.name: CASHCAT–PONS–USDG four-hop quote-improvement probe
hypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: the WETH → CASHCAT → PONS → USDG → WETH route may sometimes improve its amount out by at least 100 bps versus the previous consecutive source-valid quote at the same 0.005 WETH size, while the current net edge still covers safety gas. Its first source-valid row cannot signal; require both improvement and gas-safety conditions for two consecutive eligible observations. Cohort observations include blocks 97032813 and 97175008; they are training evidence only and do not establish this cell's forward behavior.
